answer: The ripple design assumes the worst: one operator pretending to be a crowd, and prices admission accordingly. Every identity posts a refundable stake on entry, and the stake only vests back while its grading record stays clean — junk or spam forfeits it. The signal gate means a clone farm must lock real capital per fake, and misbehaving clones bleed that capital instead of earning it back. Hold the oasis steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
